 Highlights Today’s AFC Champions League Elite Match Schedule and Broadcast Channels 
 Today’s Champions League match schedule and broadcast channels 
 Today’s Gulf Champions League match schedule and broadcast channels 
 Football fans will be glued to their screens today, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, for a series of exciting matches in continental competitions. The highlight is the clash between Shabab Al-Ahli and Al-Hilal of Saudi Arabia in the AFC Champions League. In addition, several other highly anticipated matches are scheduled in the UEFA Champions League and the Gulf Champions League.
 The Champions League fixtures include Barcelona vs Aston Villa, Manchester United vs Roma, and Atlético Madrid vs Bayern Munich. Additionally, Paris Saint-Germain will face Villarreal today.
 Below are the match times for today in UAE time, and the broadcasting channels.
 Today’s AFC Champions League Elite Match Schedule and Broadcast Channels
 Esteghlal Tehran vs Al Shamal: 8:00 PM UAE time, 6:00 PM Egypt time, 7:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will be broadcast on beIN Sports 2 and Al Kass 5 HD.
 Al Hilal vs Shabab Al Ahli: 10:15 PM UAE time, 8:15 PM Egypt time, 9:15 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 2 and Al Kass 5 HD.
 Today’s Champions League match schedule and broadcast channels
 Galatasaray vs Stuttgart: 9:45 PM UAE time, 7:45 PM Egypt time, 8:45 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 3.
 Shakhtar Donetsk vs Sporting Lisbon: 9:45 PM UAE time, 7:45 PM Egypt time, 8:45 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 4.
 Villarreal vs Paris Saint-Germain: 12:00 AM UAE time, early Wednesday morning. 10:00 PM Egypt time, 11:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 3.
 Manchester United vs Roma: 12:00 midnight UAE time, early Wednesday morning. 10:00 PM Egypt time, 11:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 4.
 Atletico Madrid vs Bayern Munich: 12:00 midnight UAE time, early Wednesday morning. 10:00 PM Egypt time, 11:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 5.
 Barcelona vs Aston Villa: 12:00 midnight UAE time, early Wednesday morning. 10:00 PM Egypt time, 11:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will be broadcast on beIN Sports 1.
 Feyenoord Rotterdam vs Inter Milan: 12:00 midnight UAE time, Wednesday morning. 10:00 PM Egypt time, 11:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on beIN Sports 8.
 Today’s Gulf Champions League match schedule and broadcast channels
 Al-Zawraa vs Al-Riffa: 6:30 PM UAE time, 4:30 PM Egypt time, 5:30 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on Al Kass 1 HD.
 Al Shabab vs Hadhramaut Youth: 6:45 PM UAE time, 4:45 PM Egypt time, 5:45 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on Al Kass 4 HD.
 Neom vs Al-Duhail: 10:00 PM UAE time, 8:00 PM Egypt time, 9:00 PM Saudi Arabia time. The match will also be broadcast on Al Kass 1 HD.
